title: Rayen Castle

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain immediately outside the interpreted eastern entrance, reviewed with the public-domain Qualla elevation.

mapIdentity.scope: 147 outer building points record the entire present fortress perimeter, including 12 named-in-controls rounded perimeter arcs. The eastern gate and interior volumes are estimated from the photographs and written context.

note: The exact Qualla views resolve rounded exposed merlons, tapered parapet and cylindrical gateway. The unchanged 384-metre native field provides the ground contact.
